add.title: Add Recipe
add.urlPlaceholder: Paste a recipe URL (website, Instagram, TikTok...)
add.urlIntro: Add one or more links. Use + to add another row. One link opens a preview to edit before saving; several links are extracted and saved automatically (up to {{max}} unique URLs).
add.imageIntro: Upload photos for one recipe — add several images if the recipe spans multiple screenshots (up to 15 per recipe).
add.imageBatchIntro: Use "Add another recipe" to queue multiple recipes. Each block is one recipe; one block opens preview, several blocks are read and saved automatically (up to {{max}} recipes per run).
add.imageDrop: Drop images here or tap to upload (multiple allowed)
add.imageTapToAdd: Use the + tile to add more images (up to 15).
add.previewHintUrl: Recipe extracted from the link. Pick a cover image from the page if you like, then review and save.
add.previewHintScreenshot: Recipe read from your screenshot. Pick a cover URL or upload a photo if you like, then review and save.
add.bulkMaxNote: Up to {{max}} items per run. Duplicates are skipped.
add.bulkSkippedInvalid: {{count}} field(s) had invalid URLs and were skipped.
add.bulkTruncated: Only the first {{max}} unique items will be processed.
add.bulkTruncatedGroups: Only the first {{max}} recipes will be processed.
